phase_policies.applies_when: At around 180 seconds, with heavy economy and technology investment, and unknown enemy composition possibly including Marines and Reapers.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when more information about enemy army composition is available or if early pressure is detected.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize tech and economy, keep production moderate, and ensure scouting for safety.
phase_policies.target: Increase production and technology while maintaining a safe economy; scout to clarify enemy intentions.
phase_policies.title: Early Tech and Economy Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to technology without scouting or neglect defense against possible early pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 300 seconds, with a ground-oriented army including Stalkers, facing a ground posture with Marines and Widow Mines, and heavy economy and production.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if enemy shows signs of air transitions or if heavy pressure requires defensive adjustments.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on ground army, keep expanding, and maintain production and tech upgrades.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army while increasing production and technology; maintain economy and expansion pace.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army Strengthening with Expansion
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect defense or overextend without confirming enemy air transitions.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 480 seconds, with a ground-oriented army and heavy production/technology, facing Siege Tanks, Marines, and Banshees.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if enemy transitions to more air units or if composition adjustments are needed.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Build anti-Siege units, keep tech and production high, and adapt to enemy composition.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army and add units to handle Siege Tanks, such as Immortals or Void Rays; increase production and technology.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Army and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not ignore potential air threats or overcommit to ground without scouting for air transitions.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600 seconds, with a ground-oriented army including Void Rays, facing a ground posture with Marines, Reapers, Marauders, and Hellions.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck if enemy adapts with anti-air or if composition adjustments are needed.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance ground and air, exploit Void Ray advantage, and keep production and tech progressing.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army while maintaining air support from Void Rays; increase production and technology, and consider more air units if enemy lacks anti-air.
phase_policies.title: Late Midgame Ground and Air Flexibility
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect ground defense or overcommit to air without confirming enemy anti-air capabilities.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
